gpu_suitability_audit.rationale: Inference consists of single-sample evaluations of a 100-tree shallow decision forest intertwined with sequential streaming feature extractor updates. Host-to-device PCIe transfer overhead (5-10ms) exceeds total single-core CPU execution time (~0.05ms). GPU acceleration would degrade latency rather than improve it.
